body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/core ### Is this a regression? Yes, the previous version in which this bug was not present was: v8 ### Description After updating to angular 9 from angular 8 (but it is not related to the update as it is reproducible in clean ng9 repo), my angular component stopped working, and the issue is related to the `Optional()` DI mechanism, when used inside of an angular element component.

Peculiarities: - If used without ivy, the issue disappears (i.e. `"angularCompilerOptions": {"enableIvy": false}`). - If optional DI is used outside of angular elements component, it works without any issues. - Also, if the angular element component is used within some other _normal_ angular component, there will be no issue, only when it is used directly within `index.html` or any other nonangular environment (which is where the angular elements components mostly get used anyway). - One more thing I noticed is that when the injection is tried in next tick (i.e. wrapped inside of `setTimeout(()=>{...}, 0)`) the issue is gone as well. - Moving `createCustomElement` call from the module constructor to `ngDoBootstrap` also fixes issue, but it is probably for the same reason as the above bullet. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction Since the stackblitz is infamous for its angular elements support (and the template is not updated for ng9, I made a github repo for that: https://github.com/pmilic021/angular-elements-optional-repro . ## 🔥 Exception or Error 

test.module.ts:20 Trying to load Router in `test.module.ts`...
test.module.ts:21 success
test.component.ts:11 Trying to load Router in `test.component.ts`...
test.component.ts:14 fail TypeError: Cannot read property 'get' of undefined
    at NgModuleRef$1.get (core.js:35665)
    at Object.get (core.js:33422)
    at getOrCreateInjectable (core.js:5498)
    at NodeInjector.get (core.js:5746)
    at new TestComponent (test.component.ts:12)
    at NodeInjectorFactory.TestComponent_Factory [as factory] (test.component.ts:16)
    at getNodeInjectable (core.js:5643)
    at instantiateRootComponent (core.js:12570)
    at createRootComponent (core.js:26011)
    at ComponentFactory$1.create (core.js:33544)
test.component.ts:11 Trying to load Router in `test.component.ts`...
test.component.ts:12 success
The test module is the module that creates the angular elements component (as seen in repro git provided). Test component is the component turned into the angular elements component. The one failing to load Router module is the one called from `index.hmtl` and the one that succeedes is the one called from `app.component.ts`. ## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:** 

Angular CLI: 9.0.3
Node: 10.15.3
OS: darwin x64

Angular: 9.0.2
... animations, common, compiler, compiler-cli, core, elements
